tooltip.ninjacatpack.loomframe.1: Stretch a mesh, hopper grit in the top, sit it on a hopper for scraps. Same table as an Ex Deorum sieve, a little less per block because it runs itself.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.loomframe.2: Empty hand takes scraps; sneak to pull the mesh. Mesh is hand-only. Redstone pauses it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tension_barrel.1: Pour water (bucket comes back) and add dirt → clay. String + ender pearl → 2 yarn.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tension_barrel.2: Holds 8 of each. Empty hand takes what settled; sneak to pull dry inputs.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.loom_lint: Combed out of dirt by a thread mesh. Four make a Void Yarn.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.strand_filament.1: Rare iron-mesh catch. 16 of them at a Tension Post spin a Braid Cord.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.strand_filament.2: No Strand has to be seated — the Post is enough.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.frayed_thread: Unravel: 1 Thread → 3 string. /clowder hub Kin stalls sell things for Thread.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.thread_skein: Nine Frayed Thread, wound. Big stall prices are paid in skeins; unwind one back into nine Thread.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.thread_bolt: Nine Thread Skeins on a bolt (81 Thread). Spark prices the Nether Star in bolts; unwind one back into nine skeins.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.thread_shard.1: A quarter of a shared life. Four make a Thread of Return.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.thread_shard.2: Craft: diamonds, Void Yarn and a Rift Shard. Or buy one from Spark in Clowder Hall for 44 Thread Skeins (396 Thread).
tooltip.ninjacatpack.thread_of_return: Grit in Clowder Hall buys blocks and netherite back for Thread — badly, on purpose.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.blueprint_package: Four Blueprint Paper, shapeless. Right-click to unwrap starter plans. Claiming a pad wipes Silent Gear's join gift.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.sky_stone_tank: Does not keep fluids when broken — that is AE2, not a pack bug. Bucket them out, or move liquids in a Spirit Cistern.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.rotten_flesh: Smelt or campfire it for leather. Zombies on the pad are the cow.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.freshmilkitem: Coconut plus freshwater, or split a milk bucket. There are no cows on the pad.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.coconutitem: Iron-mesh dirt grows the palm. Craft with freshwater for kitchen milk.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.silkentofuitem: Soybean in a saucepan. Counts as egg and as raw meat for chili. Roll it for firm tofu.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.firmtofuitem: Silken tofu plus the roller. Counts as raw meat until animals exist.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.leather: Smelt rotten flesh, or sieve dirt with flint mesh and up. Pad-keepers in Clowder Hall sell a little.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.void_yarn.1: Early: 4 string → 2 yarn. Later: string + pearl in the Tension Barrel → 2 yarn.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.void_yarn.2: Or four Loom Lint from the Loomframe.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.binding_knot.1: Void Yarn ring around a slime ball. The Loom's soft gate.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.binding_knot.2: Early slime: 2 dirt + wheat seeds + bone meal.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tension_post.1: Seat Strand tokens here. Each one lights a notch, chimes for the Clowder, and changes the pad.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tension_post.2: Braid Cord and the Spindle Loom Fragment are spun here, not crafted.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.braid_cord: Two braid paths, one cord. Heart of the molecular assembler.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.spindle_loom_fragme: Seat it at the Tension Post to Reweave.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.inferium_essence: Smelt Inferium Ore — sieve dirt for it. Hostile mobs drop essence too.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.prosperity_shard: Smelt Prosperity Ore — sieve gravel or sand. Rarer than Inferium; it gates seed bases.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.inferium_ore: From the sieve. Smelt for Inferium Essence — the floor of every crop tier.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.prosperity_ore: From the sieve. Smelt for a Prosperity Shard — every seed base needs one.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.productivebees_nest: A ring of this around a small flower. Place it, then right-click it with a small flower to wake the bee.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.oak_wood_nest: Also spawns plain honey bees — the root of every breeding line.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.bee_nest: Planks and flowers. A wild bee will move in; shear it with smoke underneath.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.pulse_resonator: Seat a reusable Echo catalyst. Distinct totem voices strengthen the song; a Voice Ring at radius 3 is what six voices now means. Redstone pauses it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.ley_collector: Place under open sky. Night, rain, water, plants and totem voices add. A strong pad keeps nearby totems answered. Redstone pauses it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.pulse_cell: Carry Pulse between Drumheart, Ley, generators and the pit.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.drumheart: Strike empty-handed on tempo (17–23 ticks) for 24 Pulse, 10 off-tempo. Redstone pays only a rising edge — a lever left on is not a drum. Nothing closer than 8 ticks counts.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.march_stone: Right-click a Tension Post with it once nine Strands are seated.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tribe_hearth: Offer what the tribe favours. Standing opens trades, then the Mark. Sixty standing a day per tribe. Do not break it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tribe_mark: An Elder gives it once, at Voice. Craft it into a Kinship Totem.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.kinship_totem: One more voice for the Pulse Resonator — up to fifteen with all nine tribes.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.loom_thread: Ancestor Halls, The Unsung, or a Loom-stitcher at Friend. The sixth voice starts here.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.silent_drum: Four strikes, a breath apart. Sneak against the Beat; answer the Silence with the same rhythm.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tribalpower_rite: Sneak-use on a Ritual Brazier with the matching seal seated. A tablet wants a Rite Circle. Pulse comes from the lattice around it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.bonding_charm: Adult familiar. Animals keep a failed charm; remnants spend it and want Voice with their tribe. One fighter and two helpers may follow.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.camp_charter: Use on a player to invite them into a Tribal Power camp. /tribalpower camp create <name>, invite, join. Shared vault, twelve anchors, quartered standing.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.ley_lens: Hold to see the ley. Sneak-use a Ley Collector, or a familiar, for its numbers.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.lattice_tuner: Mark a machine face, then use on a relay. Do not mark the plate. Or seat the same unique item in both Bond slots.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.item_relay: Snap onto a machine face. Pair Bond slots or tuner-bind a destination. Hoppers cannot steal the Bond or Rune.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.fluid_relay: Snap onto a tank face. Water Seal moves fluid, Earth Seal moves items; empty uses the plate name.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.stone_font: Four chalk marks. Cobble at 4 Pulse/s; Earth for stone; Fire and Water, or water plus lava, for obsidian. Sneak-use the Codex on it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.resonance_mesh: Centre of a Listening Pit. Sample on top is a filter. Mining stays cheaper.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.anchor_stone: Braces a font, a pit and a Far Gate. Four corners.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.gate_frame: A five-by-five Way Gate ring without its corners. Keystone at the bottom centre.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.gate_keystone: Lights the gate. Waystone Compass or chalk within 64 blocks; Gate Sigil for a Far Gate.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.gate_sigil: Names a Far Gate pair. Loom voice nearby. 120 Pulse a traveller.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.ember_horn: Fire. Burns furnace fuel for up to 20 Pulse a second while lit.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.wind_harp: Air. Altitude, open sky, weather. Harps within 12 blocks divide the wind.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.wave_drum: Water. Adjacent water or piped. Passive drums within 8 blocks divide the water.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.wake_bell: Spirit. Nearby deaths, tolled out at no more than 8 Pulse a second.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.loom_anchor: Loom. One Pulse a second per distinct nearby voice, doubled during a Ley Binding.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.pulse_cairn: 4,000 Pulse. Stack five. Turns a bursty bell into a steady pit.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.music_disc_drum_cir: From a chest at the Drum Circle, or from The Unsung. Play it in a jukebox.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.shard_lamp: 1–2 Pulse a second. Redstone dims it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.glow_reed: Cheap Pulse lamp. Redstone dims it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.echo_sconce: Wall Pulse lamp. Redstone dims it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.ember_bowl: Bowl Pulse lamp. Redstone dims it.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.sky_charm: Wear in a Tribal charm slot. Sneak-use a totem to bind a voice. Sky with Air is creative flight.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.chorus_charm: Binds every nearby totem voice at a Ritual Brazier.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.seal_loom: Weaves Recipe Seals. Empty bottles return to the slot that held them.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.tide_pump: Moves cistern fluid. Rank it at Echo stations; rank survives pickup.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.ember_kiln: Fire totem. Smelts grit and every furnace recipe for Pulse.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.pulse_adapter: 1 Pulse = 100 FE. Unranked 20 Pulse/s. Rank at Echo stations. Cannot receive FE.
tooltip.ninjacatpack.wind_charm: Hang from a ceiling. March camp furniture.
